qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the holder to transfer case on the 265 Sport transmission?
What is the torque specification for the retaining plates for bearings on housing?
Which transmission types use the retaining plates for bearings on housing specification?
Which component uses a 9 Nm torque specification in the Case and Cover section?
Which fastener has a higher torque specification - the holder to transfer case or the retaining plates for bearings?
qa_pairs.answer: The retaining plates for bearings on housing has a higher torque specification at 10 Nm compared to 9 Nm for the holder to transfer case.

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual covers these torque specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 23.11 - Case and Cover under Manual Transmission (23-6)
